sourceOfTruth: This file is the production launch evidence gate. Do not mark external checks READY without attached provider, CI, runbook, or sign-off evidence.

items.item: Production-like Meta webhook verification uses an explicit META_WEBHOOK_APP_SECRET
items.reasonMissing: Production/staging provider secret evidence for META_WEBHOOK_APP_SECRET has not been attached. Local placeholder documentation is not production evidence.

items.item: Deployed Meta bot service is explicitly classified as production/staging
items.evidence: Release Gate uses APP_ENV=production and NODE_ENV=production in .github/workflows/release-gate.yml. Deployment-provider runtime evidence is still required.
items.reasonMissing: No provider evidence has been attached showing the deployed meta-bot-backend service runs with APP_ENV=production or APP_ENV=staging and NODE_ENV=production. A public/staging deployment running as development could otherwise use the local META_APP_SECRET fallback and is not launch-ready.

items.item: Lead mutation routes require operator-level authorization or stricter
Production release gate requires website-lane tenant smoke
Provider backup policy and restore drill are proven before production launch
items.reasonMissing: No provider snapshot policy, latest backup timestamp, or successful restore drill evidence has been attached. The repo cannot create or verify provider backups by itself.

items.item: Paid launch has explicit pricing, payment/manual invoice, quota limits, cancellation/refund, and support terms
items.reasonMissing: Paid pilot and public paid SaaS terms are not defined or approved. Billing readiness, manual invoice process, usage limits, refund/cancellation terms, and support ownership are missing.

items.item: Production readiness checklist is evidence-based and signed off
items.evidence: Gate script: scripts/check-launch-evidence.mjs; source file: docs/launch/production-launch-evidence.json; docs/PRODUCTION_READINESS.md
items.reasonMissing: Launch-critical evidence is still BLOCKED and no human go/no-go approver has signed off this evidence file.
